budget_items.what_was_recorded: The banked ARPA money earned interest, and the Board needs clarification on whether it follows ARPA rules or regular appropriation.
budget_items.quote: the banked money earned $101,889 in interest.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committed ARPA sub-recipient amounts were listed for the Water District, Boys & Girls Club and Food Pantry/Lions Club.
budget_items.quote: recipients are water district ($285,000), boys & girls club ($175,000) and food pantry/lions club ($20,000).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Member Emkey reported Westford is using ARPA funds for PFAS well testing.
budget_items.quote: westford is using $20,000 of arpa funds to test 50 private wells across town for pfas.

budget_items.topic: Proposed consultant for old town dump solar
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair Jeffreys suggested spending ARPA funds to hire a consultant on putting solar on the old town dump.
budget_items.quote: chair jeffreys suggested using $25,000 to hire a consultant

budget_items.topic: 40S local aid shortage for Tri-Town students
